outcome: women's experiences of pregnancy, birth and postpartum
fear and anxiety about attending visits
tensions within personal and family relationships
cohort: The study included 1137 women from across all 34 provinces in Indonesia, comprising 842 pregnant women and 295 postpartum women.
finding: Women in Indonesia reported that the COVID-19 pandemic added an increased burden across physical, psychological, spiritual, and financial aspects during pregnancy, birth, and the post-partum period, alongside disrupted maternity services and unresponsive health insurance.
mod_finding: 13% of women were denied the presence of a birth companion, and 28% reported that their babies had been removed at birth due to protocols or the baby's health.
cross-section timing: Data were collected between 10th July to 9th August 2020
